nodes.name: CuCo(OH)2 Electrochemical Co-precipitation
nodes.procedure: The solution for CuCo(OH)2 was prepared with 30 mM Co(NO3)2·6H2O and 20 mM Cu(NO3)2·2.5H2O. The electrodeposition was conducted with -1 V (vs. SCE) for 5 min on the pre-treated NF working electrode with Ti-mesh counter electrode. The electrode was rinsed several with deionized water and then dried in a convection oven.
